test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"mostly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Mostly"** means mainly or for the most part.
 
• **"Mostly" **means in almost every case; almost all the time. (अधिकांशतः, मुख्‍यतया, अधिकतर)
 
 
• **Example**: *Our students come **mostly**__ from Japan.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits in the context of the sentence.
 
• The other options do not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

An 'occupational disease' is any disease __caused__ primarily by exposure at work __to__ a physical, organisational, chemical or biological risk __factor__ or to a combination of these factors. Occupational diseases are __**mostly**__ those listed in national legislation as resulting from exposure to risk factors at ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"radically"**, means in a drastic or extreme manner. (आमूल, मूल रूप से, मूलतः)
 
• Option 2, **"oddly"**, means in a strange or peculiar way. (विचित्र रूप से (विचित्र बात है कि))
 
• Option 4, **"manually"**, means by hand or using physical labour. (हाथ या हाथों से)

46:Tac5,

The correct answer is **"work."**
